newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel barge firms, premiums stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel barge firms, premiums stable.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were stable in lacklustre business on Tuesday, traders aid
Outright prices firmed with Dec IPE futures, $2.75 higher at $221.50.
Barges premiums were at Dec IPE +$29 fob Rotterdam, barely changed from $28.75 done on Friday and discussion at +$29 on Monday. Cargoes were around Dec IPE +$30.
In the Med Libyan was steady at high cif quotes +$2.50 for small parcels and +$5 for large ones. EU-qualified was notionally around high cif quotes +$6.
